type.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Plumbing, Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Examiners.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Division" means the Division of Professional Regulation.

required.quote: Has received a journeyman's certificate issued in any state following completion of an HVACR, or HVACR restricted apprenticeship program that meets or exceeds the Federal Bureau of Apprenticeship and Training Standards and, thereafter, performed HVACR, or HVACR restricted services for 2 years under the supervision of a master HVACR licensee
required.citation: § 1821. Qualifications of applicant — Heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration.

experience_source.quote: has performed HVACR or HVACR restricted services for 7 years under the supervision of a master HVACR licensee or master HVACR restricted licensee or an individual holding a similar level of licensure in another state
experience_source.citation: § 1821. Qualifications of applicant — Heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration.

duration.value: 2 years post-journeyman's certificate (or 7 years total under supervision)
duration.quote: performed HVACR, or HVACR restricted services for 2 years under the supervision of a master HVACR licensee, or master HVACR restricted licensee; or has performed HVACR or HVACR restricted services for 7 years under the supervision of a master HVACR licensee
duration.citation: § 1821. Qualifications of applicant — Heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration.

exams.name: Written standardized examination for master HVACR licensee or master HVACR restricted licensee
exams.notes: Offered at least quarterly; Board determines passing score. After 3 failed attempts, Board may specify conditions under which applicant may retake.
exams.jurisdiction: state (designated by the Board and approved by the Division)
exams.quote: Has achieved the passing score on a written, standardized examination, designated by the Board and approved by the Division, for licensure as a Delaware master HVACR licensee or master HVACR restricted licensee
exams.citation: § 1821. Qualifications of applicant — Heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration.

interval_years.quote: A license is renewable biennially in a manner determined by the Division, upon payment of the appropriate fee, submission of a renewal form provided by the Division, and proof that the licensee has met any continuing education requirements established by the Board.

required.quote: proof that the licensee has met any continuing education requirements established by the Board

available.quote: the Board shall grant a license to each applicant who presents proof of current licensure in good standing in another state, the District of Columbia, or a territory of the United States whose standards for licensure are substantially similar to those of this State

requirements.value: Applicant must present proof of current licensure in good standing in another state/DC/territory with substantially similar standards and submit verified evidence per § 1821(a)(3)-(7). If standards not substantially similar, must have practiced for minimum 7 years after licensure.
requirements.quote: An applicant who is licensed by another state, the District of Columbia, or a territory of the United States whose standards for licensure are not substantially similar to those of this State must have practiced for a minimum of 7 years after licensure

exists.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Plumbing, Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Examiners.

national_certification.quote: Has been certified at the appropriate level for handling chlorofluorocarbons (CFC's) by a testing organization approved by the Environmental Protection Agency
national_certification.citation: § 1821. Qualifications of applicant — Heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration.

regulatory_model.quote: A person shall not provide HVACR or HVACR restricted services in this State nor hold oneself out to the public as being a master HVACR licensee or master HVACR restricted licensee

credential_type.quote: "License" means a document issued by the Board of Plumbing, Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Examiners certifying that the holder has met the requirements of this chapter and is a master plumber, master HVACR licensee, or master HVACR restricted licensee.

is_mandatory.quote: A person shall not provide HVACR or HVACR restricted services in this State nor hold oneself out to the public as being a master HVACR licensee or master HVACR restricted licensee

title_protection.quote: nor use "master HVACR licensee", "master HVACR restricted licensee" in connection with that person's name nor otherwise assume or use any title or description conveying or tending to convey the impression that that person is qualified to provide HVACR or HVACR restricted services

scope_protection.quote: A person shall not provide HVACR or HVACR restricted services in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception to acquire a license, allowed another to use the license, or aided an unlicensed person to represent themselves as licensed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception in order to acquire a license, has allowed another person to use that licensee's license, or has aided or abetted an unlicensed to represent oneself as an individual licensed pursuant to this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1827. Grounds for discipline or other remediation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Illegally, incompetently, or negligently provided HVACR or HVACR restricted services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Illegally, incompetently, or negligently provided HVACR or HVACR restricted services
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1827. Grounds for discipline or other remediation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been convicted of an offense substantially related to providing HVACR or HVACR restricted services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of an offense that is substantially related to providing HVACR or HVACR restricted services.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1827. Grounds for discipline or other remediation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used illegal drugs, used prescription drugs without a prescription, excessively used legally prescribed drugs, or abused alcohol/drugs impairing the ability to provide services safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the last 2 years used illegal drugs; used prescription drugs without a prescription; excessively used legally prescribed drugs; or abused alcoholic beverages or drugs to the extent that it impaired that licensee's ability to provide services authorized under this chapter with reasonable skill, competence, and safety to the public
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1827. Grounds for discipline or other remediation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in consumer fraud or deception, restraint of competition, or price-fixing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in an act of consumer fraud or deception, engaged in the restraint of competition, or participated in price-fixing activities
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1827. Grounds for discipline or other remediation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a provision of this chapter or any lawful regulation established thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a provision of this chapter or any lawful regulation established hereunder
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1827. Grounds for discipline or other remediation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had the license as a master HVACR licensee or master HVACR restricted licensee suspended, revoked, or subjected to other adverse action in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had that licensee's license as a master HVACR licensee or master HVACR restricted licensee suspended or revoked, or been subjected to other adverse action taken by the appropriate licensing authority in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1827. Grounds for discipline or other remediation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to notify the Board that the licensee's license in another jurisdiction was subject to discipline, surrendered, suspended, or revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to notify the Board that the licensee's license to provide services authorized under this chapter in another jurisdiction has been subject to discipline, or has been surrendered, suspended, or revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1827. Grounds for discipline or other remediation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A physical or mental impairment that prevents the licensee from providing services with reasonable skill, competence, and safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A physical or mental impairment that prevents that licensee from providing services authorized under this chapter with reasonable skill, competence, and safety to the public.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1827. Grounds for discipline or other remediation.

definition_quote.value: "HVACR services" means the design, installation, construction, maintenance, service, repair, alteration, or modification of a product or of equipment including gas piping in heating and air conditioning, refrigeration, ventilation, or process cooling or heating systems.
definition_quote.quote: "HVACR services" means the design, installation, construction, maintenance, service, repair, alteration, or modification of a product or of equipment including gas piping in heating and air conditioning, refrigeration, ventilation, or process cooling or heating systems.

methods_authorized.quote: the design, installation, construction, maintenance, service, repair, alteration, or modification of a product or of equipment including gas piping in heating and air conditioning, refrigeration, ventilation, or process cooling or heating systems

system_components_included.quote: "HVACR restricted services" means HVACR services that are limited to 1 of the following specialties: a. Heating — forced air systems; ventilation; and gas piping; or b. Heating — hydronic systems and gas piping; or c. Commercial hood systems; or d. Refrigeration; or e. Air-conditioning; or f. Gas piping.

qualifier_required.quote: If a partnership, firm, corporation, or other artificial entity that provides services regulated under this chapter suffers the loss of its sole license holder, the entity shall notify the Board in writing with supporting documentation within 7 days of the loss of its license holder.
qualifier_required.citation: § 1831. Artificial entity's loss of license holder.

qualifier_license_type_required.quote: "Supervision" means control and oversight by a master licensee who is an owner or full-time employee of the entity providing services.

qualifier_cessation_notification_days.quote: the entity shall notify the Board in writing with supporting documentation within 7 days of the loss of its license holder.
qualifier_cessation_notification_days.citation: § 1831. Artificial entity's loss of license holder.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: At the meeting the Board may issue a temporary license to the applicant, valid for 100 days, dated from the date of notification to the Board by the entity
qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.citation: § 1831. Artificial entity's loss of license holder.

gas_appliance_certification_required.quote: Has been certified at the appropriate level for handling chlorofluorocarbons (CFC's) by a testing organization approved by the Environmental Protection Agency
gas_appliance_certification_required.citation: § 1821. Qualifications of applicant — Heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration.

license_number_on_permits_required.quote: The Board shall require that all persons licensed in plumbing and HVACR services display the words "Licensed Plumber" and/or "Licensed HVACR" and the license number assigned to them in not less than 3-inch letters and numbers on the vehicles used in the performance of their work.
